en: The postcard depicts a pastel-colored scene with a large blue Easter egg decorated with daisies in a basket with flowers in the foreground. A charming house with a red roof appears in the background, along with lush greenery and blooming plants. The postcard has a soft, hand-tinted look typical of early-20th-century images. The lower right has the text 'Ela 2487', possibly the artist's name and a serial number.
